name: What safety considerations are important for electrical work during a renovation?

mainEntity.name: What safety considerations are important for electrical work during a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Safety is paramount during remodel electrical work. This includes turning off power at the main breaker before any work begins. Proper insulation of wires, secure connections, and correct grounding are crucial to prevent shocks and fire hazards. Always use appropriate tools and personal protective equipment. Ensure all new installations meet current electrical codes, and never overload circuits. If you're unsure, always defer to a licensed professional.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key safety considerations for electrical renovations include turning off power, proper insulation, secure connections, grounding, and code compliance.
